Description.Name: Return of the Goat and the Lutefisk
Description.Details: You are midway through a drink with Darius in a dimly lit bar on Goat Path when a familiar voice cuts through the noise around you. "Commander! What a remarkable coincidence!" You look up from your drink and immediately recognize the strange man you rescued from the rival corporation during your last visit to Goatpath. He still looks as though he stepped directly out of one of those antiquated Terran holovids about wizards, though the assortment of chemical vials hanging from his belt now makes him appear equally suited to an alchemist's laboratory. Darius stares at him over the rim of his glass. "You're the wizard." The man smiles warmly. "Chemist, technically. Wizard only by reputation. Though I have found the distinction becomes less important after several drinks." You remember your previous conversation clearly. The man had offered to introduce you to a legendary MechWarrior in exchange for the goat and crate of lutefisk sitting somewhere aboard the Argo. You had declined, explaining that your barracks were already full. The chemist pulls up an empty chair and sits beside your table without waiting for an invitation. "I have been thinking about our previous conversation, Commander. You said you had no room for another MechWarrior." "I did." The chemist nods. "A perfectly reasonable concern. Space aboard a DropShip is a valuable resource. But circumstances change. People leave. Contracts end. Occasionally, someone is launched through an airlock. Such is the nature of mercenary employment. Occasionally, commanders decide they have made a terrible mistake and reconsider a previous offer." Darius slowly sets down his drink. "You came all the way to this bar hoping that last one happened?" The chemist smiles. "I came here because this is Goatpath. Eventually, everyone ends up in this bar." Darius looks around the establishment. "That explains several things." The chemist leans forward. "So, Commander, let us discuss the matter again. If you now have room for a MechWarrior, I am prepared to honor my original offer." You already know what comes next. "The goat and the lutefisk." The chemist's eyes brighten immediately. "The goat and the lutefisk." Darius closes his eyes. "I still don't understand how those two things are related." "Chemistry, my good Darius," the man replies. "A magnificent and frequently misunderstood science." Darius glances toward you. "He's doing this on purpose." The chemist ignores him. "Give me the goat and the crate of lutefisk aboard your DropShip, and I will introduce you to the MechWarrior I promised you. A remarkable warrior with abilities that I assure you will justify this admittedly unusual transaction." You lean back in your chair and consider the offer. The original problem was simple: there had been no room for another MechWarrior aboard the Argo. But that was then. Darius studies your expression and sighs. "Commander, I know that look. We're about to make another personnel decision involving a goat, aren't we?" The chemist raises his glass. "So, Commander... has room become available?"

Description.Name: The Argo is not a Halfway House
Description.Details:
You shake your head politely. "I appreciate the offer, but this isn't a halfway house. I'm not hiring an unknown MechWarrior simply because you call them legendary. I have no idea what they can actually do, or even their skill, and I'm not trading a goat and a crate of lutefisk to find out."

The wizard's smile fades slightly. "A pity, Commander. You may never know what you turned down."

Description.Name: Fire [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] for more room
Description.Details:
You consider the offer for a moment before turning toward Darius.  "We can make room."

Darius raises an eyebrow. "Commander?"

You scroll briefly through your datapad and point at one entry: [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]. "We'll terminate [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]'s contract and make the space available."

The chemist smiles. "Then I believe we have a deal."

Darius looks less convinced. "You're really firing a MechWarrior to make room for someone we've never met?"

You look back at the strange man in wizard's robes. "Apparently."

The chemist simply smiles. "You won't regret it."

<color=#f69c24>Jarl Jarlson is now in your barracks</color>

Description.Name: Let's Do This!
Description.Details:
You look from the wizard to Darius, then back again. "All right. We have a deal. The goat and the lutefisk are yours. Bring me this legendary MechWarrior."

The wizard's face breaks into a broad grin. "Excellent! You won't regret this."

A short time later, you meet Jarl Jarlson, an enigmatic JàrnFòlk MechWarrior whose origins are shrouded in unanswered questions and whose resemblance to the missing Carl Marik has earned him an unfortunate reputation for making questions disappear along with the people asking them.

Whatever his origins, Jarl is an exceptionally effective battlefield commander, best known for his unconventional mastery of mortar launchers. His infamous tactic of loading them with lutefisk allows him to blind enemy cockpits and sensors while sowing confusion across the battlefield, earning him a reputation as one of the JàrnFòlk's most unconventional and effective warriors.

You look toward Darius. "Remind me to never ask what was actually in that lutefisk."

<color=#f69c24>Jarl Jarlson is now in your barracks</color>
